facts.text: I am planning a shopping trip to Target this weekend.
I am trying to maximize my savings on baby supplies.
I am looking for coupons for baby supplies like diapers.
I used a $5 off coupon on a pack of diapers last week.
I am looking for coupons on baby food.
I am looking for coupons on baby formula.
I have been using a spreadsheet to track my coupons.
I am open to exploring other options than a spreadsheet to track coupons.
I like the idea of using a coupon app or a digital note system to keep track of coupons.
I think it might be a good idea to take pictures of my physical coupons and store them digitally.
I have a decent camera phone.
I want to keep track of my cashback apps in my digital coupon system.
I want to create a digital note with sections for each cashback app.
I want my digital note to include the app name, offer details, expiration dates, and redemption rules.
I want to set reminders for offer expiration dates and when new offers become available.
I want to track my savings from each cashback app, including how much I have earned and redeemed.
